name: mc1_sl_teleports_manual
description: Multicore stage 1, teleports by hand. The owner logs in at home (-StartRegion), teleports to the busy region (-BusyRegion) when the pop-up asks; about 20 s after arriving one Tracy capture (MC1-teleports-manual) runs for 600 s while the owner teleports by hand between the busy region and home (about five round trips, 30 s or more apart); then the final pop-up. No automated teleports (busy regions such as Risk refuse teleports to points inside them), no still/moving captures, no fps probe.

owner_teleport.ready_message: Teleport to Risk now. About 20 s after you arrive a 10-minute capture starts: then teleport by hand Risk -> Isle of Repose -> Risk, about 5 round trips, 30 s or more apart, until the 'Session done' pop-up.
